# What it costs to rent an NVIDIA H100

NVIDIA H100 prices from every provider listed here, what changes them, and what a month costs.

Prices as of 14 Nov 2026, 14:19 UTC

An NVIDIA H100 rents from $1.99 per GPU-hour on-demand and $1.29 on spot, across the 6 providers listed here. The tables below are this site's current prices: they change when the providers' prices do.

## Whole H100 machines

Large clouds rent the H100 mostly as machines with eight GPUs. The machine price covers its CPUs, memory and local disks too; these are the cheapest region for each machine, on-demand.

| Provider | Machine | GPUs | Per hour | Per GPU-hour | For 730 hours |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| AWS | p5.48xlarge US East (N. Virginia) | 8 | $55.04 | $6.88 | $40,179 |
| Azure | Standard_ND96isr_H100_v5 US West 3 | 8 | $98.32 | $12.29 | $71,774 |

## What changes the price

The version. On-demand, the PCIe 80 GB starts at $1.99, the NVL 94 GB starts at $2.59 and the SXM 80 GB starts at $2.69. PCIe is a card that fits a standard server slot. It runs at lower power than SXM and links to other GPUs more slowly, and it is usually the cheaper version to rent. NVL is a PCIe card made to be paired with a second one over an NVLink bridge, so the two share data quickly. It draws less power than the SXM version. SXM is a module mounted on NVIDIA's HGX board, where GPUs share data over NVLink. It runs at full power with the fastest links between GPUs, which is why 8-GPU training machines use it.

The pricing type. The cheapest spot price, $1.29 at Azure, is 35% below the cheapest on-demand price. Spot capacity can be taken back at short notice; see spot or on-demand.

The provider. Each provider's cheapest on-demand price runs from $1.99 at RunPod to $6.98 at Azure: 3.5 times as much for the same GPU family.

The region. Azure charges $12.29 per GPU-hour for its Standard_ND96isr_H100_v5 in US West 3 and $21.64 in ZA North, for the same machine.

## A month of H100 time

One H100 for a month of 730 hours costs $1,453 at the cheapest on-demand price. On spot it is $942, if the capacity is not taken back. Eight of them for the same month come to $11,622 at that rate; the cheapest whole eight-GPU machine listed here, p5.48xlarge at AWS, is $40,179.

## Questions

How much does an NVIDIA H100 cost per hour?

On-demand from $1.99 per GPU-hour (RunPod), and spot from $1.29 (Azure). Each provider's cheapest price runs from $1.99 to $6.98.

How much does an NVIDIA H100 cost per month?

About $1,453 for one GPU running all month (730 hours) at the cheapest on-demand price, and $11,622 for eight.

Is the NVIDIA H100 cheaper on spot?

Yes: the cheapest spot price is 35% below the cheapest on-demand price. Spot capacity can be reclaimed at short notice, so it suits work that can stop and resume.

Which provider rents the NVIDIA H100 cheapest?

RunPod, at $1.99 per GPU-hour on-demand for the PCIe 80 GB (Community Cloud).
